justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/runtime/IRuntime.java and the 6 implementations RuntimeJava.java, RuntimeGroovy.java, RuntimeJRuby.java, RuntimeJavaScript.java, RuntimeKotlin.java, RuntimeScala.java (7 files, 546 total LOC). They form a small cohesive adapter set: each class only launches one language runtime and maps a source file to a class name. LanguageManager.java instantiates these as a narrow factory, so the package is not excessively large and does not centralize many unrelated responsibilities.
